PR & INFLUENCER MARKETING INTERN
JULY STARTING
13 MONTHS
An exciting opportunity for a graduate to join Coty's Luxury PR & Influencer Marketing team. This role offers hands-on experience across PR and Influencer Marketing supporting some of the world's most iconic beauty brands including Burberry, BOSS, Chloé, Calvin Klein and many more!
THE ROLE
OPTIMIZE, ENABLE, INNOVATE!
As our PR & Influencer Marketing Intern, you will play a key role in supporting the delivery of integrated PR and Influencer Marketing activity across Coty's beauty portfolio. Reporting into the PR & Influencer Marketing team, you will contribute to brand advocacy initiatives including press engagement, influencer activities and operational excellence.
You will be reporting to the PR & Influencer Marketing Manager, and you will manage:
PR & Media Relations
Support the execution of PR strategies and press office activities across multiple beauty brands.
Assist in building and maintaining relationships with media contacts and industry KOLs
Support media outreach, press releases/e-blast creation and coverage tracking, while responding to press requests in a timely manner
Monitor industry trends, cultural moments and competitor activity to identify opportunities for brand visibility
Influencer Marketing & Brand Advocacy
Support the delivery of influencer marketing campaigns, including seeding activities, events and partnerships.
Help identify and engage relevant creators aligned with brand objectives and audiences.
Maintain influencer databases and support relationship management activities.
Monitor creator activity, competitor activations, and emerging social trends.
Contribute to advocacy reporting, insights and campaign evaluations leveraging Traackr.
Team Operations & Project Support
Contribute to the efficient day-to-day running of the PR & Influencer Marketing function, providing team support, coordination and administration across campaigns and key business processes.
Provide administrative support across PO management, product samples logistics, tracking systems and team documentation, maintaining accurate records and efficient team processes.
Support the planning and execution of press and influencer events.
Support cross-functional collaboration with internal teams and external partners.
YOU ARE A COTY FIT
You are passionate about communications, content, social media and culture. You thrive in a fast-paced environment, enjoy building relationships and are highly organised with strong attention to detail.
Previous work experience is preferred but not essential, however the ability to understand the key elements and an interest of the role is essential.
Recently obtained a degree in either Public Relations and media communications preferred;
Excellent knowledge of MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint);
Excellent organization and prioritising skills;
Ability to work effectively to deadlines;
Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal;
Ability to build strong working relationships;
Experience of working effectively in a team;
Demonstrate an interest and awareness in social media activities.
If you’re ready to support and shape the future of beauty, we want you on our team!
WHAT WE OFFER
This is a unique role with a genuine opportunity to make an impact. You’ll get to work in a diverse environment with a team of professionals who are passionate about the work they do and know how to have some fun along the way.
Coty’s global omni-working policy provides the option to work up to 50% of your month remotely.
We believe that a more flexible philosophy of remote working will give everyone the freedom to choose what works for their individual circumstances and empower them to always perform at their best.
ABOUT US
Our people make us who we are. They are the brightest minds bringing the boldest ideas to life every day. If you’re the kind of person who refuses to settle, if you want to think bigger, learn faster and go further than you ever thought possible – we’d love to hear from you.
Coty is deeply committed to Changing the Conversation around Diversity, Equity & Inclusion to create a more open, inclusive, and diverse workplace where all employees can be their authentic self.

Entrepreneurial Mindset: Proven ability to develop creative solutions thinking analytically and conceptually. Solution provider and problem solver.
Self-starter: Passionate, enthusiastic, thrives on challenges and keeps a healthy attitude under pressure, takes charge of self-development.
Team Player: Ability to develop effective working relationships being able to collaborate and influence others demonstrating integrity and respect.
Collaborative approach: Collaborates easily with others and adapts to different working styles.
Organized: Able to organize own work, multitasker

We drive growth, brand equity and customer loyalty with innovative products, digital campaigns, events, partnerships and in-store executions. Paid internship

Location: Amsterdam COTY HQ
Duration: 6 months (40 hours per week)
Start Date: January 2027

Advance our total investment tracking capability by creating benchmarks and guidelines on how to allocate the commercial mix.

Map the current distribution landscape to identify growth opportunities and potential risks.
Gather best practices on the 4Ps (Product, Price, Place, Promotion) across the region and enable sales managers with clear action plans.

Create operational efficiencies by optimizing and simplifying existing processes.

We are looking for a proactive, analytical thinker who thrives in a fast-paced environment and wants to make an immediate impact. To succeed in this role, you bring:
Current enrollment as an HBO or WO student (Bachelor or Master) for the entire duration of the internship.
A strong passion for the beauty industry, our brands, and FMCG market dynamics.
A proactive, flexible, and hands-on mindset with an enthusiasm for tackling complex challenges.
A genuine passion for analytical work paired with advanced Excel skills .
Strong communication skills and a collaborative, team-oriented attitude.
Fluency in English.

Coty is one of the world’s largest beauty companies, boasting an iconic portfolio of brands across fragrance, color cosmetics, skin care, and body care. Student (Bachelor/Master), it is important you remain enrolled with your university.

Global BI & Analytics Internship
5-6 MONTHS INTERNSHIP
February 2027 starting
We're Coty, a global leader in beauty. We're #1 in the world for Fragrance and #3 in the world in Colour Cosmetics with a portfolio of brands that have been known and loved for generations.
Our iconic portfolio of more than 77 brands are sold in over 150 countries around the world. We believe in beauty with a purpose and brands that inspire, no matter where they are in the world. Coty is committed to building a workforce that is as diverse as the communities we serve. Hiring people with different backgrounds and experiences helps us build better products, better serve our users, and build a diverse and inclusive workplace.
WHAT YOU WILL DO:
Based at our HQ in Amsterdam-Zuid (Amsterdam, Coty HQ), you will join our team as part of Coty’s Data Talent Factory, a structured 6-month rotation program designed for students eager to build hands-on skills in data, analytics, and generative AI. This internship is full-time (40 hours per week), for a duration of 5-6 months starting from Summer 2027. Remote working is possible up to 50% of your time, in alignment with your line manager. The internship can be combined with a thesis, though this will largely have to be done in your own time.
The Business Facing BI team plays a pivotal role in implementing a variety of business intelligence and data analytics solutions to enable data-driven decision-making globally. We actively set and refine Power BI guidelines to ensure scalable, secure, and innovative BI practices across Coty. Although our team is small, we are diverse with members based in Amsterdam and New York City. We embrace continuous learning and rapid adoption of cutting-edge technologies, actively exploring how generative AI is reshaping the way we build and deliver analytics.
Months 1–2: Training in Power BI and Databricks fundamentals with the Global BI team at our HQ in Amsterdam-Zuid, focusing on Coty’s standards and best practices, including exploration of generative AI capabilities within these platforms.
Months 3–4: First project rotation with a business analytics team, applying your skills to real projects across the organization.
Months 5–6: Second project rotation with a different business analytics team, applying your skills to real projects across the organization.
WHAT YOU WILL BRING:
Must-Haves:
Student (Bachelor/Master) — it is important that you remain enrolled with your university.
Demonstrated passion for data and an interest in specializing in Power BI and Databricks.
Strong analytical skills and proficiency with numbers.
Strong interest in generative AI and its practical applications in data & analytics.
Adaptability and willingness to work across different teams and business domains.
Keen eye for detail to ensure high-quality, aesthetically pleasing outputs.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.
Nice-to-Haves:
Familiarity with data analysis tools such as Excel, Python, SQL, and R is highly advantageous.
Application Requirements:
Please send your motivation letter together with your CV, stating your availability and for how long.
WHAT WE BRING:
At Coty, we offer an exceptional opportunity for our Global BI & Analytics interns to gain hands-on experience in a vibrant and dynamic environment. By the end of the program, you’ll have a portfolio of real deliverables, cross-functional exposure, and a strong foundation for a career in data & analytics. You will receive direct mentorship from the Business Facing Power BI Manager, fostering both personal and professional growth, alongside an inclusive, supportive work environment that encourages collaboration and innovation.
Great opportunities to work across multiple analytics teams and manage end-to-end projects.
Internship allowance, NS Business Card (if you are not eligible for a student public transport card), staff discount on Coty products, and access to Coty Academy.
Convenient office location (near Amsterdam Zuid station) with lots of fun in-house events.
First-hand knowledge about the beauty industry.
“My internship with the Global BI & Analytics team was truly unique. It went far beyond dashboards and data, offering a deep dive into strategy, stakeholder management, and the complexities behind scalable BI products. I was exposed to projects across finance, HR, and transformation teams, which helped me understand the company better while building a strong foundation that supports my current role as a Supply Finance Analyst.” – Esmat Fayaz, Supply Finance Analyst
